qualifier: with podosome assembly and early endosome maturation
name: Macropinocytosis with ruffle formation and early endosome maturation
rationale: All members concern ruffle-driven fluid uptake (macropinocytosis, pinocytosis, ruffle and podosome assembly) and onward early-to-late endosome traffic, unlike confusables centred on lamellipodial migration, Rho GTPase cycles or caveolar/clathrin endocytosis and transcytosis.

name: Mitochondrial import, protein processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members cover import of proteins, RNA and calcium into mitochondria, presequence processing and degradation of mitochondrial proteins, and cristae/outer membrane organization, distinct from respiratory-chain assembly and from fission/mitophagy confusables.

qualifier: Hedgehog autoprocessing/palmitoylation and RAS C-terminal processing
name: Protein lipidation and processing of Hedgehog and RAS
rationale: Members share lipid modification (palmitoylation, depalmitoylation, N-terminal lipidation) and self-processing of Hedgehog plus RAS C-terminal processing, which separates them from Wnt/PORCN, GPI-anchor and geranylgeranylation confusables.

core: Cellular response to oxidative and nitrosative stress
name: Cellular response to peroxides and reactive nitrogen species
rationale: All members are responses to hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides or nitric oxide and reactive nitrogen species, unlike confusables about stress-induced apoptosis, hypoxia/ischemia or ROS detoxification enzymes.

qualifier: Tfh/ICOS-CD27 co-stimulation and B cell memory
name: Germinal center B cell response, Tfh co-stimulation and memory
rationale: Members describe B cell activation, proliferation and germinal center differentiation driven by T follicular helper/ICOS and CD27 co-stimulation leading to memory B cells and humoral memory, beyond the general B cell development modules of the confusables.

core: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
name: Excitatory amino acid and GABA transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate/aspartate reuptake and homeostasis (including SLC1/SLC17A8 disorders) plus GABA synthesis, degradation, secretion and reuptake, unlike glycinergic, vesicular-loading or cholinergic confusables.

qualifier: brainstem/pons with locomotor, suckling and respiratory control
name: Brainstem development, locomotor and respiratory motor behavior
rationale: Members combine hindbrain, brainstem and pons development with brainstem-dependent behaviours (locomotion, righting, suckling, neural control of breathing), separating it from cerebellar granule/Bergmann glia and hindbrain migration confusables.

qualifier: CDX/HNF4-driven absorptive epithelium, plus leukocyte migration
name: HNF4/CDX-driven enterocyte identity and leukocyte migration
rationale: Two of three members are CDX/HNF4-driven absorptive enterocyte gene programmes (vs crypt-stem, secretory or bile-acid confusables); leukocyte migration is an unrelated singleton that has to be named separately.

name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
rationale: Every member is resistance of ERBB2 kinase-domain mutants to a specific TKI, whereas confusables describe constitutive signalling by EGFR/ERBB2/FGFR/PDGFRA mutants rather than drug resistance.

qualifier: of PE, PS, PG and PC
name: Acyl-chain remodeling of PE, PS, PG and PC phospholipids
rationale: Members are acyl-chain remodelling of phosphatidylethanolamine, -serine, -glycerol and -choline within glycerophospholipid metabolism, unlike confusables on de novo phospholipid synthesis, PI remodelling or DAG/TAG metabolism.

name: Nociceptive and thermal sensation, itch and fever
rationale: Members are detection of noxious mechanical/thermal stimuli, thermoception, pain behaviour, itch and fever with neuronal excitability, separating it from taste/smell, touch and the K2P channel confusable that lacks itch and fever.

name: RUNX2-driven osteoblast development and intramembranous bone formation
rationale: Members center on RUNX2 regulation of osteoblast differentiation, direct ossification, cranial suture and trabecular bone, with tendon and cartilage morphogenesis, distinct from chondrocyte/endochondral, Wnt-mesenchymal and osteoblast proliferation-regulation confusables.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and TKI resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR mutants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are signalling by and inhibitor binding/resistance of KIT, PDGFR and ALK mutants plus FGFR fusions/amplifications, distinguished from confusables dominated by FLT3 mutants, EPO/cytokine signalling and cytosolic PDGFR fusions.

qualifier: E-cadherin assembly, turnover and EMT regulation
name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and E-cadherin turnover
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion, adherens junction assembly and CDH1/CDH11 regulation, degradation and EMT, unlike tight-junction, desmosome/hemidesmosome and apical-basal polarity confusables.

name: Enamel mineralization, dentinogenesis and tooth eruption
rationale: Members concern enamel and dentin formation, including secreted-protein phosphorylation and amelogenesis imperfecta, and tooth eruption, separating them from bone mineralization, phosphate/vitamin D and odontoblast-regulation confusables.

qualifier: cerebellar cortex layers, proprioception and voluntary movement
name: Cerebellar cortex development and motor coordination
rationale: Members combine cerebellar granular/Purkinje layer formation, Bergmann glia and granule precursor proliferation with motor learning, proprioception and locomotion, unlike brainstem/respiratory, vocal-learning and forebrain confusables.

name: Dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthase and GDP-mannose synthesis
rationale: Members are GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis and the DPM1-3 congenital disorders, distinct from confusables built on PMM2, MPI, DOLK and other CDG defects.

name: Glycoconjugate biosynthesis, degradation and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: The large majority of members cover N-/O-glycan, glycosaminoglycan, glycosphingolipid and GPI synthesis, nucleotide-sugar supply, lysosomal glycan breakdown and their inherited disorders, unlike central carbohydrate, Golgi trafficking and ECM proteoglycan confusables.

name: Hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine and hydroxylation of translation machinery
rationale: Members are unusual residue modifications of translation components (eIF5A hypusination, EEF2 diphthamide, tRNA-Phe wybutosine, lysine/proline hydroxylation) supporting elongation, unlike methylation, polyamine, selenocysteine and aminoacylation confusables.

name: Spindle orientation in asymmetric division of forebrain neural progenitors
rationale: Members link astral microtubule and spindle positioning to asymmetric division and proliferation of forebrain ventricular-zone neuroblasts and neural stem cells, unlike confusables limited to midbrain/forebrain patterning or centrosome positioning.

name: Sour taste and olfactory chemosensation
rationale: Members are sour taste, taste chemical detection and odorant sensing/smell, separating it from sweet/bitter/umami/salty taste, olfactory-receptor expression/pheromone and acid-sensing channel confusables.

qualifier: neutral amino acids across the plasma membrane
name: Neutral amino acid transport across the plasma membrane
rationale: All members are transport of neutral amino acids (glutamine, leucine, isoleucine, alanine, phenylalanine), unlike cationic amino acid, oligopeptide and organic cation/xenobiotic transport confusables.

qualifier: glycine, threonine and proline, with glycine conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glycine, threonine and proline metabolism with glycine conjugation
rationale: Members center on glycine, threonine, proline and glyoxylate metabolism plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, unlike glutamate/glutamine, alanine and aromatic/sulfur amino acid confusables.

qualifier: translation, ribosome assembly and RNA modification
name: Mitochondrial translation, ribosome assembly and RNA modification
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial translation initiation to termination, mitoribosome assembly and quality control, and mt tRNA/rRNA/mRNA modification and processing, unlike mt RNA decay, mtDNA replication and pseudouridylation confusables.

name: Raft- and caveolin-associated endocytosis and early endosomal sorting
rationale: Members concern raft assembly, caveolin- and clathrin-mediated uptake, pinocytosis regulation, transcytosis and early endosome sorting, unlike macropinocytosis/ruffling, receptor recycling and GLUT4 translocation confusables.
